scope: Pure actual shared-engine API only; no backend, Node IPC, browser, rights, translation or production acceptance.

results.name: Strict decoded duplicate/prototype/BOM/nonfinite/unsafe integer/unpaired surrogate protection
Unicode codepoint canonical order, numeric-looking keys and equivalent JSON spellings
Real JSON depth32 accepted / depth33 rejected
Draft gaps remain explicit publish blockers and never invent approval/materials/count
Multiple independent bad cards aggregate every issue without first-error truncation
Every valid JSON malformed parent returns complete diagnostics rather than throwing
Explicit null in old-clean string/object fields cannot produce a falsely applicable preview
Added/removed language and card diffs expose all five leaf fields; source declarations have visible diff
